entries.heading: The Secretary of Homeland Security shall ensure
ancestors: DIVISION F—DEPARTMENT OF HOMELAND SECURITY APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2014
entries.text:
Sec. 552.  The Secretary of Homeland Security shall ensure 
enforcement of immigration laws (as defined in section 101(a)(17) of the 
Immigration and Nationality Act (8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(17))).
